title: 第30章 雨夜荒庄，神秘男子！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
轰隆！

    一道惨白的闪电撕裂夜空，将城西这座废弃山庄照得亮如白昼。

    沉闷的雷声滚滚而来。

    紧接着，黄豆大的雨滴倾盆而下。

    狂风卷着暴雨，狠狠砸在破败的瓦砾与泥泞的庭院中。

    天地间瞬间拉起一道密不透风的雨帘。

    雨水冲刷着地上的血泊，汇聚成一条条暗红色的溪流，顺着石阶蜿蜒流淌。

    林琬背靠着半截断裂的石柱，大口大口地喘着粗气。

    冰冷的雨水顺着她的脸颊滑落，流进脖颈。

    “林神捕，你的命真硬。”

    面具男的声音穿透雨幕，带着一丝戏谑与残忍。

    “中了我的摧心掌，又被围攻了这么久，居然还能站着。”

    他缓缓举起长剑，剑尖对准了林琬的咽喉。

    “可惜，今夜没人能救你。”

    “下辈子，别再这么自作聪明了。”

    林琬咬紧牙关，口腔里满是浓烈的血腥味。

    绝望如同这漫天的暴雨，铺天盖地地压了下来。

    “就这么轻易要死了吗，我不甘心，我还没有……”

    她死死盯着眼前的面具男，瞳孔中倒映着那柄急速放大的长剑。

    剑锋撕裂雨幕，带着尖锐的呼啸声，直刺她的咽喉。

    避无可避。

    挡无可挡。

    林琬缓缓闭上眼睛。

    结束了。

    “铛——！”

    一声震耳欲聋的金铁交击声，骤然在暴雨中炸响。

    火星四溅。

    预想中的刺痛并没有传来。

    林琬猛地睁开眼睛。

    狂风呼啸。

    一道模糊的青色残影，不知何时撕裂了密集的雨幕，如同鬼魅般出现在她的身前。

    一只强有力的手臂，稳稳地揽住了她的腰肢。

    一股温暖而霸道的气息，瞬间驱散了她周身的寒意。

    林琬整个人跌入一个宽阔结实的胸膛。

    她呆呆地抬起头。

    映入眼帘的，是一件被雨水打湿的青色长衫。

    以及一张劣质的、画着夸张笑脸的戏曲面具。

    面具上的油彩在雨水中微微泛着光，透着一股说不出的诡异与滑稽。

    但此刻，这个戴着滑稽面具的青衫男子，却宛如一座不可逾越的高山，挡在了她的身前。

    男子的右手握着一把连鞘的黑色长刀。

    漆黑的刀鞘，正死死架住面具男那必杀的一剑。

    狂暴的劲气以两人为中心，向四周轰然扩散。

    地面的积水被瞬间排空，形成一个方圆丈许的真空地带。

    面具男面色大变。

    他只觉一股排山倒海般的恐怖巨力，顺着剑身疯狂涌入自己的右臂。

    虎口瞬间崩裂。

    鲜血飞溅。

    他闷哼一声，整个人如同被狂奔的犀牛撞中，双脚贴着泥地向后滑行了七八步，犁出两条深深的沟壑，才勉强稳住身形。

    整条右臂剧烈颤抖，几乎握不住手中的长剑。

    全场死寂。

    只有暴雨砸在地面上的哗啦声。
content_en:
Boom!

    A pale lightning tore through the night sky, illuminating the abandoned villa in the west of the city as bright as day.

    Dull thunder rolled in.

    Immediately afterwards, raindrops as big as soybeans poured down.

    The strong wind brought heavy rain, slamming down on the dilapidated rubble and muddy courtyard.

    An airtight rain curtain was instantly drawn between heaven and earth.

    The rain washed away the pools of blood on the ground, forming dark red streams that meandered along the stone steps.

    Lin Wan leaned against the half-broken stone pillar, breathing heavily.

    The cold rain slid down her cheeks and into her neck.

    "Lin Shenzhen, your life is really tough."

    The masked man's voice penetrated the rain curtain, with a hint of teasing and cruelty.

    "You were hit by my Heart-Destroying Palm, and you were besieged for so long, and yet you are still standing."

    He slowly raised his sword and aimed the tip at Lin Wan's throat.

    "It's a pity that no one can save you tonight."

    "In the next life, stop being so smart."

    Lin Wan gritted his teeth, his mouth filled with the strong smell of blood.

    Despair was like the heavy rain in the sky, pressing down overwhelmingly.

    "Is it so easy to die? I'm not willing to accept it. I haven't yet..."

    She stared intently at the masked man in front of her, the rapidly enlarging long sword reflected in her pupils.

    The sword edge tore through the rain curtain, with a sharp whistling sound, and pierced her throat.

    There is no way to avoid it.

    Unstoppable.

    Lin Wan slowly closed his eyes.

    it's over.

    "Dang——!"

    A deafening sound of gold and iron clashing suddenly exploded in the heavy rain.

    Sparks flew everywhere.

    The expected sting did not come.

    Lin Wan opened his eyes suddenly.

    The wind howled.

    A blurry cyan afterimage tore apart the dense rain curtain at some point and appeared in front of her like a ghost.

    A strong arm held her waist firmly.

    A warm and domineering aura instantly dispelled the chill all over her body.

    Lin Wan fell into a broad and strong chest.

    She raised her head blankly.

    What caught his eye was a blue gown that was wetted by the rain.

    And a shoddy opera mask with an exaggerated smile.

    The paint on the mask shone slightly in the rain, revealing an indescribable weirdness and comedy.

    But at this moment, this man in green shirt wearing a funny mask was like an insurmountable mountain, blocking her way.

    The man's right hand held a long black sheathed knife.

    The dark scabbard was holding the masked man's killing sword firmly.

    The violent energy centered on the two people and spread to all directions.

    The water on the ground was drained instantly, forming a vacuum zone about ten feet in diameter.

    The masked man's expression changed drastically.

    He felt an overwhelming and terrifying power rush into his right arm along the blade of the sword.

    The tiger's mouth collapsed instantly.

    Blood splattered.

    He groaned, as if he had been hit by a running rhinoceros. He slid back seven or eight steps against the mud with his feet, plowing two deep ravines before he could barely stabilize his body.

    His entire right arm was shaking violently, and he could barely hold the sword in his hand.

    The whole place was dead silent.

    There was only the sound of heavy rain hitting the ground.
title_en: Chapter 30 A mysterious man in a deserted village on a rainy night!
